desc:
Catch adorable anime catboys, battle wild ones, and build the coziest cat cafe on Roblox! 🐾💕

⚔️ Battle wild catboys and throw Yarn Balls to catch them  
☕ Put your catboys to work in your cafe and earn cash  
🌸 Explore 10 unique zones, from Catnip Meadow to Pumpkin Hollow  
👑 Defeat giant Boss Catboys to unlock new zones  
✨ Collect 150+ catboys and hunt for rare GOLD and RAINBOW variants  
🎡 Train your Capture Power on the Cat Wheel and in Yarn Blocks  
🏠 Upgrade your cafe and watch it grow bigger and better  
🔄 Rebirth for huge boosts and even more earnings

🐱 Build your collection. Grow your cafe. Catch them all!
